motto: Where every meal comes with a story you shouldn't repeat

paris.contact: Aunt Gertrude (Mortimer's third wife, don't mention the incident)

restaurants.name: Le Canard Suspicieux
restaurants.specialty: Duck confit prepared in the 'old way' (ask for 'le parapluie')
restaurants.secret_menu_item: The Midnight Cassoulet - only served after 11pm, requires knowing the password 'Mortimer sends his regards'
restaurants.backstory: Chef Pierre once saved Mortimer's life during a truffle-hunting accident in Périgord. Now honors that debt with unlimited cassoulet for Guild members.

restaurants.name: Boulangerie Fantôme
restaurants.address: Behind the green door at 7 Place des Secrets
restaurants.specialty: Croissants baked with butter from cows that only eat moonlit grass
restaurants.secret_menu_item: The Invisible Éclair - it's in a box you can't see, but you'll taste it in your dreams
restaurants.backstory: Madame Dubois is Mortimer's former chess opponent. She lost a bet in 1987 and now must provide free pastries to anyone who can recite the first line of 'Les Misérables' backwards.

tokyo.contact: Mr. Tanaka (actually Mortimer's twin, separated at birth, it's complicated)

restaurants.name: Kitsune no Ramen
restaurants.address: B2F, behind the vending machine that dispenses philosophy, Shibuya
restaurants.specialty: Ramen with broth simmered for exactly 47 years
restaurants.secret_menu_item: The Nine-Tailed Bowl - contains one ingredient from each of Mortimer's nine ex-wives' family recipes
restaurants.backstory: Chef Yuki discovered the recipe in a dream after eating Mortimer's 'special brownies' at a 1970s commune in Oregon.

restaurants.name: Sushi Temporal
restaurants.address: The building that wasn't there yesterday, Ginza
restaurants.specialty: Fish aged in a time dilation chamber (allegedly)
restaurants.secret_menu_item: Omakase from Tomorrow - Chef serves what he predicts you'll want to have eaten yesterday
restaurants.backstory: Master Hiroshi won the restaurant in a poker game against Mortimer. The stakes also included a 'temporal aging device' that Mortimer claimed fell off a UFO.

new_york.contact: Big Tony (not actually big, it's ironic)

restaurants.name: The Speakeasy Speakeasy
restaurants.address: Say 'rutabaga' to the hot dog vendor at 53rd and 6th, follow the pigeon
restaurants.specialty: Prohibition-era cocktails made with pre-1920 ingredients (they have a bunker)
restaurants.secret_menu_item: The Mortimer Manhattan - whiskey older than the concept of regret, served in a glass that belonged to Teddy Roosevelt
restaurants.backstory: The owner's grandmother was Mortimer's bootlegging partner. The family still has the original tunnels.

restaurants.name: Babushka's Impossible Dumplings
restaurants.address: Brighton Beach, behind the store that sells only left shoes
restaurants.specialty: Dumplings folded in dimensions humans can't perceive
restaurants.secret_menu_item: The Family Secret Pelmeni - recipe transmitted telepathically from grandmother to grandmother since 1847
restaurants.backstory: Nadia's grandmother saved Mortimer from a bear in Siberia. She taught him that true bravery is eating her cooking without flinching.

rome.contact: Father Giuseppe (not actually a priest, just likes the outfit)

restaurants.name: Trattoria dei Segreti Sepolti
restaurants.address: Under the fountain that no tourist has ever found, Trastevere
restaurants.specialty: Pasta made with techniques forbidden by the Culinary Council of 1623
restaurants.secret_menu_item: Cacio e Pepe della Nonna Immortale - the cheese is blessed, the pepper is cursed, the balance is perfect
restaurants.backstory: The Rossi family has been hiding from the Vatican's culinary inquisitors for 400 years. Mortimer helps them with new identities.

restaurants.name: Gelato Esistenziale
restaurants.address: The alley where the cats judge you, Campo de' Fiori
restaurants.specialty: Flavors that make you question your life choices (in a good way)
restaurants.secret_menu_item: The Flavor of Your Forgotten Childhood Summer - tastes different for everyone, usually involves crying
restaurants.backstory: Marco was Mortimer's philosophy professor before the 'incident with the gelato machine and the existentialist crisis'. Now he only speaks in frozen metaphors.

bangkok.contact: The Lady Who Knows (she'll find you, don't worry)

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารที่ไม่มีชื่อ (The Restaurant With No Name)
restaurants.address: Take the third left after you think you're lost, Chinatown
restaurants.specialty: Street food elevated to cosmic significance
restaurants.secret_menu_item: Pad Thai of Enlightenment - the noodles are arranged in patterns that convey universal truths
restaurants.backstory: Grandma Somchai taught Mortimer that the secret to good food is accepting that you know nothing. She was also his meditation teacher and bookie.

restaurants.name: The Diplomatic Incident
restaurants.address: Above the embassy that doesn't exist, Sukhumvit Soi ???
restaurants.specialty: Cuisine from countries that aren't on any map
restaurants.secret_menu_item: The Treaty Violation Tasting Menu - each course from a different culinary tradition that was 'borrowed' without permission
restaurants.backstory: Chef Preecha was a actual diplomat until the incident Mortimer refuses to discuss. Now serves food that requires signing a waiver.

sydney.contact: Dangerous Doug (actually very safe, it's a nickname from childhood)

restaurants.name: The Upside Down Bakery
restaurants.address: You have to enter through the ceiling, Surry Hills
restaurants.specialty: Meat pies that defy gravitational expectations
restaurants.secret_menu_item: The Mortimer's Revenge Pie - contains a different exotic meat each day, you don't get to know which
restaurants.backstory: Doug lost a bet to Mortimer involving a kangaroo, a helicopter, and the Sydney Opera House. The details are classified by ASIO.

restaurants.name: Barramundi & Existential Dread
restaurants.address: The boat that's somehow always at a different dock, Darling Harbour
restaurants.specialty: Seafood caught using methods too Australian to explain
restaurants.secret_menu_item: The Deep Conversation Fish - your waiter is a retired philosopher who will discuss Nietzsche while you eat
restaurants.backstory: Captain Margaret was Mortimer's sailing instructor. She taught him that the sea takes everything eventually, especially your appetite for normal food.

disclaimer: Uncle Mortimer's Global Gastronomic Guild is not responsible for temporal anomalies, existential crises, or unexpected enlightenment that may occur while dining at member establishments. Side effects may include: questioning reality, developing a taste for the unusual, and an inexplicable urge to learn more about Mortimer's past. Guild membership is hereditary, accidental, or achieved through acts of culinary bravery.
